curriculumHighlights.text: There is no branch change at the end of the first year: the 2024-25 UG regulations state this explicitly, so the JoSAA/CSAB allotment is the branch a student graduates in.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - rule 2.8 (no branch change)

curriculumHighlights.text: The B.Tech needs a minimum of 150-160 credits (as fixed by each department) with a CGPA of at least 5.00, plus mandatory non-credit courses; the degree takes at least four years and must be completed within eight. One lecture hour a week over a 14-week semester earns one credit, a lab hour half a credit.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - rules 3.4-3.5 (credits, degree requirements)

curriculumHighlights.text: Minor programmes: 15 extra credits (five courses, or four plus a project) in a discipline offered by another department, from the 3rd semester, for a one-time fee. A student may take one minor, two minors, or a minor plus honours; an NCC minor with relaxed CGPA eligibility is open to school-level NCC cadets.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - section 16 (Minor Program)

curriculumHighlights.text: Honours: 15 additional credits within the student's own department from the 5th semester, finishing by the 8th; the degree is awarded as the discipline 'with Honors'. Honours credits can be carried into an M.Tech in the relevant specialisation at the institute.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - section 17 (Honors Program) and M.Tech credit transfer note

curriculumHighlights.text: Every student must complete either a 6-8 week summer internship (industry, research organisation or a premier academic institute, NIT Warangal included) or an EPICS community-service project under a faculty guide, and present the work to a departmental evaluation committee.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - rule 9.8 (Summer/research internship / EPICS)

curriculumHighlights.text: An optional 8th-semester internship arranged through the placement centre (CCPD) is open to students with CGPA above 6.50 and no backlogs up to the 7th semester; the remaining 8th-semester courses are done by self-study or SWAYAM/NPTEL, and the internship project counts as the final-year project.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - section 18 (Semester Internship)

curriculumHighlights.text: The curriculum mixes basic-science, engineering-science and humanities cores with programme-core and elective courses, open electives (sciences, engineering, humanities or management), minor/major projects and mandatory non-credit courses. Students below 5.00 CGPA after the 2nd semester are flagged via the ERP.

sources.title: Academic Regulations of UG Programs 2024-25 - section 3.1 (course structure) and rule 9.9 (slow learners)

research.note: NIT Warangal runs a large doctoral programme for an NIT: its NIRF 2025 submission lists 642 full-time and 433 part-time PhD scholars enrolled up to 2023-24, with 125 PhDs (101 full-time, 24 part-time) awarded in 2023-24 alone. Externally funded work in FY 2023-24 comprised 161 sponsored projects from 39 agencies worth about Rs 19.4 crore, plus 107 consultancy projects for 84 client organisations worth about Rs 2.9 crore. The institute also hosts a Centre of Excellence in Additive Manufacturing and a Centre for Teaching and Learning.
